ICS 87.040CHD 20New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies the requirements and methods of sampling and test for silicone soya alkyd exterior paint for application on exterior structures located in marine environment. This paint is one component system suitable for application by brush/spray.2.
